description: Retrieve a research result by the id that a_share_deep_research returned. Call this to check whether the human-reviewed answer is ready, or to fetch the full text once it is. Answers take minutes to hours because a filed report is read first; while it is still queued the tool returns the queue position, not a guess. Use this instead of opening the public page when you are an automated client that cannot render HTML.

id.description: The 12-character hex id returned by a_share_deep_research, e.g. dc037a7fc6c8.

name: a_share_answer_by_id
